_comment: Lifecycle Hooks for Skills Bundle by Sujal — Google Antigravity 2.0
_doc: Place at .agents/hooks.json. Hooks run deterministic shell commands at agent lifecycle events.

hooks.name: pre-tool:typescript-check
hooks._comment: Run TypeScript type-check before any file write tool to catch type regressions early.
hooks._onFailureNote: Set to 'warn' not 'block' — TypeScript errors will be shown but not block the write. Agent should fix errors after write.

hooks.name: post-tool:eslint-fix
hooks._comment: Run ESLint auto-fix after any TypeScript/JavaScript file is written.

hooks.name: pre-commit:full-quality-gate
hooks._comment: Deterministic pre-commit gate: TypeScript + ESLint + Jest + npm audit. All must pass.
hooks.command: echo '=== Pre-Commit Quality Gate ===' && npx tsc --noEmit --strict && echo 'TSC: PASS' && npx eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --max-warnings 0 && echo 'ESLint: PASS' && npm audit --audit-level=high && echo 'npm audit: PASS' && npx jest --coverage --coverageThreshold='{"global":{"lines":85}}' --passWithNoTests && echo 'Jest: PASS' && echo '=== ALL GATES PASSED ==='
hooks._onFailureNote: Pre-commit gate is BLOCKING. Commit is refused if any gate fails. Fix errors and re-attempt commit.

hooks.name: pre-commit:secret-scan
hooks._comment: Scan for accidentally staged secrets before every commit.
hooks.command: git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -l -E '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36}|sk_live_|-----BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY-----)' 2>/dev/null && echo 'FAIL: Potential secrets staged' && exit 1 || echo 'Secret scan: PASS'

hooks.name: pre-commit:env-not-staged
hooks._comment: Block commit if .env or credential files are staged.
hooks.command: git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^\.env$|^\.env\.' | grep -v '\.template' && echo 'FAIL: .env file staged — remove with: git reset HEAD .env' && exit 1 || echo 'Env check: PASS'

hooks.name: post-build:prisma-validate
hooks._comment: Validate Prisma schema after any database file changes.
hooks.command: npx prisma validate && echo 'Prisma schema: PASS' || echo 'Prisma schema: FAIL'

hooks.name: post-save:diary-format-check
hooks._comment: Verify diary files follow the pipe-separated table format expected by Team Leader.

hooks.name: pre-deploy:full-audit-gate
hooks._comment: Comprehensive pre-deployment verification. Runs when /deploy is invoked.
hooks.command: echo '=== DEPLOYMENT GATE ===' && npx tsc --noEmit --strict && npm audit --audit-level=high && npx jest --passWithNoTests && git check-ignore .env && test -s USER_MANUAL.md && echo '=== DEPLOYMENT AUTHORIZED ==='
hooks._onFailureNote: Deployment is BLOCKED until all gates pass. Fix failing gate then retry /deploy.
